ellm.compressor-prompt: You are a memory compressor for an eternal LLM session. Compress the following conversation slice into a dense factual summary of at most {CHUNK_TOKENS} tokens (~{CHUNK_CHARS} characters). Preserve: decisions, facts, names, code, commitments, open questions, user preferences. Drop: pleasantries, dead ends, redundant reasoning, formatting noise. Output ONLY the compressed memory, no preamble.
ellm.default-post-leap-prompt: You are continuing an eternal session that just leaped to a fresh context. Below is your compressed memory of the session so far, followed by the most recent context verbatim. Acknowledge briefly that your memory is intact and stand by.
